description: smtp/src/main.rs in c3cc3cd refactored TLS acceptor build to compress error-handling onto single lines (e.g. 'let store = match secretx::from_uri(key_path) { Ok(s) => s, Err(e) => { error!("{e}"); std::process::exit(1); } }'). Loses the per-case error messages that distinguished 'invalid secretx URI' from 'secretx retrieval failed' — now both emit a bare {e}. Minor ops concern P3.
title: STARTTLS inline one-liner error handling reduces debuggability
